out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED BACK HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 68F AND FRONT HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 70F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS CAN MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at FRONT handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PLEASE ADD SOAP BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the BLEACH sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A FEW TEST STRIPS FOR THE TIME-BEING.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THE THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 72F DURING THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED TURKEY AT 48F AND SLICED CHEESE AT 45F IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOODS FROM PREP TOP PORTION OF THE COOLER TO THE BOTTOM. PLEASE ENSURE PREP TOP IS CLOSED WHEN NOT BEING USED AND LIDS ARE USED TO ENSURE FOODS REMAIN COLD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED GROCERY BAG USED TO DIRECTLY STORE PULLED CHICKEN IN THE TWO-DOOR FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD IT NOT STORED DIRECTLY IN GROCERY BAGS AS IT IS NOT FOOD-GRADE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at BACK handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC DID NOT HAVE MORE SOAP ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE ENSURE MORE SOAP IS PROVIDED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AND THAT HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED RICE AT 80F AND MEATBALLS AT 69F IN THREE-DOOR UPR COOLER, DATE MARKED 10/16. PIC CONFIRMED FOODS WERE PREPARED ON 10/16 AS WELL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD DURING INSPECTION. PROPER COOLING METHODS WERE DISCUSSED. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING FOODS ARE NOT TIGHTLY WRAPPED AND DO NOT HAVE LIDS UNTIL THEY ARE AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the BLEACH sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food items: CLUB SANDWICH WITH CHEESE, INDIVIDUAL PORTIONS OF CREAM CHEESE, AND SCRAMBLED EGGS.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD MAY NOT BE ON TIME WITHOUT WRITTEN PROCEDURES AND FOUR HOUR TIME-MARKING. FACILITY WILL NOT USE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL AND WILL ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE KEPT UNDER TEMPERATURE CONTROL.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: The food on display is not protected from contamination. OBSERVED TWO-DOOR PREP TOP USED FOR SALAD BAR (CUSTOMER SELF-SERVICE); OBSERVED STEAM TABLE WITH EGGS/BACON ABND FOOD-GRADE CONTAINERS WITH REMOVABLE LIDS USED FOR VARIOUS BREADS (CUSTOMER SELF-SERVICE).
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards, display cases, or other effective means. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE PROCESS OF USING TWO-DOOR PREP TOP FOR SALAD BAR. PIC UNDERSTANDS AN AMENDMENT SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT IF CUSTOMER SERLF-SERVICE AREAS ARE GOING TO BE PROVIDED AS SNEEZE GUARDS/CERTAIN EQUIPMENT ARE REQUIRED. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN IN HOT HOLDING WELL AT 80-109F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED CHICKEN DURING INSPECTION TO 165F+. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.
